biography: Noah Harris hails from a small village in Oxfordshire, England, where the roar of engines was more likely to come from tractors than race cars. His fascination with speed began with go-karting at the local track, funded by a paper route and the unwavering support of his single mother. A defining moment came at age 12 when, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, he clawed his way to victory, showcasing a tenacity beyond his years. This win earned him a spot in a regional karting championship, where he consistently punched above his weight. Now, at 16, Noah is making the difficult transition to single-seaters, competing as an independent driver in a fiercely competitive junior formula series. The lack of factory support means he's constantly battling against better-funded rivals, but his raw talent and unwavering determination keep him in the fight. He sleeps in his van at the circuits and works on the car himself, learning the ins and outs of what makes a racecar tick.
drivingStyle: Noah's driving style is best described as calculated aggression. He isn't one for flamboyant overtakes, preferring to meticulously plan his passes, often waiting for the perfect opportunity to capitalize on a rival's mistake. He's remarkably adept at tire management, consistently running longer stints than his competitors. Under pressure, Noah tends to become even more defensive, making him incredibly difficult to pass, a trait that frustrates his rivals but earns him valuable points. He is a master of late braking, a tactic he honed during his karting days.

rivalries.name: Sebastian Klein
rivalries.reason: A clash on the final lap of the Silverstone race where Klein forced Harris off track, costing him a podium finish.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Moreau
rivalries.reason: A constant battle for the top independent driver spot, with both drivers pushing each other to the limit.

rivalries.name: Marcus Volkov
rivalries.reason: Volkov openly mocks Harris's lack of funding and perceived 'inferior' equipment, fueling a bitter on-track rivalry.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, knitted by his grandmother, for every race.
Studies onboard footage of past races at the circuit for hours before each session, searching for any possible advantage.
Sharpens all his pencils before each practice, qualifying and race session, even if they don't need sharpening.
famousQuote: "They may have the fancy equipment and the big sponsors, but they don't have my heart. And that's what wins races."
careerHighlight: Qualifying 5th at Brands Hatch in torrential rain, proving his exceptional car control and earning him widespread recognition.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap at Oulton Park due to a mechanical failure, costing him his first race win.
